_meta.note: Injected into the system prompt once per run: 'neutral' always, plus the section whose key appears in the current character name. Definitions are terse mechanical facts from the wiki — no strategy. Regenerate by re-fetching the source page (WebFetch; curl is Cloudflare-blocked).

neutral.Block: Prevents damage until next turn; damage is dealt to Block before HP.
neutral.Energy: Spent to play cards; refills to 3 at the start of each turn.
neutral.Eternal: Card cannot be removed or transformed from your deck.
neutral.Exhaust: Card is removed from the deck until the end of combat.
neutral.Ethereal: Card is Exhausted if still in hand at end of turn.
neutral.Fatal: Effect triggers when this card kills a non-Minion enemy.
neutral.Innate: Card always appears in your first hand each combat.
neutral.Retain: Card is not discarded at end of turn.
neutral.Replay: Card is played an additional time in a row.
neutral.Unplayable: Card cannot be played and has no Energy cost.

Silent.Poison: Poisoned creatures lose HP equal to their Poison at end of your turn, then Poison is reduced by 1.
Silent.Sly: If this card is discarded during your turn, it immediately plays for free.

Regent.Stars: A resource generated and spent by cards, alongside Energy (some cards cost both; a cost like '1+2S' means 1 Energy and 2 Stars). Your current Stars are shown in combat. [S] in card text is 1 Star.
Regent.Forge: Forge X adds X damage to every Sovereign Blade in all zones (hand, draw, discard, exhaust). If none exists, Forging first creates one in hand.
Regent.Sovereign Blade: Colorless Attack card created by Forging; costs 2 Energy (1 when upgraded); its damage is increased by each Forge.

Necrobinder.Doom: At the end of a creature's turn, if its Doom >= its HP, it dies.
Necrobinder.Summon: Summon X summons Osty with X max HP, or adds X to Osty's HP and max HP if already alive.
Necrobinder.Osty: Necrobinder's pet. Osty absorbs all unblocked attack damage; overflow damage hits you if Osty is killed.

Defect.Channel: Channeling an Orb puts it into the leftmost empty Orb slot.
Defect.Evoke: Evoking an Orb consumes it for a stronger burst effect.
Defect.Focus: Focus X increases the effectiveness of your Orbs by X.
Defect.Lightning Orb: Passive: 3 damage to a random enemy. Evoke: 8 damage to a random enemy.
Defect.Frost Orb: Passive: gain 2 Block. Evoke: gain 5 Block.
Defect.Dark Orb: Passive: stores +6 damage. Evoke: deals stored damage to the lowest-HP enemy.
Defect.Plasma Orb: Passive: +1 Energy next turn. Evoke: gain 2 Energy.
Defect.Glass Orb: Passive: 4 damage to ALL enemies, decreasing by 1 per turn. Evoke: double its passive damage.
